movies.title: Godzilla Minus One
movies.description: In post-war Japan, a devastated nation faces a new crisis when Godzilla emerges, forcing ordinary people to confront an unstoppable force while struggling to rebuild their lives.

movies.title: Jeepers Creepers
movies.description: Two siblings traveling home for spring break become the targets of a terrifying creature that awakens every twenty-three years to feed.

movies.title: Once Upon a Time in Hollywood
movies.description: A fading television actor and his loyal stunt double navigate the changing film industry in 1969 Los Angeles as Hollywood enters a new era.

movies.title: Children of Men
movies.description: In a future where humanity faces extinction due to global infertility, a disillusioned bureaucrat is tasked with protecting the world's first pregnant woman in decades.

movies.title: Rear Window
movies.description: Confined to his apartment with a broken leg, a photographer becomes convinced he has witnessed a murder after observing his neighbors through his rear window.

movies.title: Requiem for a Dream
movies.description: The lives of four people unravel as their dreams and ambitions become consumed by addiction, leading to devastating consequences.
